name: Glitchless Perfection
source:
A visual novel where you participate in an experiment to create the perfect artificially intelligent assistant. After choosing the facial options you prefer the most, you then start interacting with the AI. Things seem to be normal... until they aren't.

[From [url=https://menimeno.itch.io/glitchless-perfection]Itch.io[/url]]
